notes: T7 infection time course 0-30 min of MG1655 with pBR322-toxIN or empty vector; every sample is T7-infected (0 min = taken at infection), so no untreated control: is_control left out. toxIN origin not stated, genotype_class left out for +toxIN. mixed_organism left out (phage RNA present in infected cells). transcription_arrested left out (T7 shuts off host transcription, not an experimental arrest). Infection at 30 C. ERCC spike-in. Library gel extraction is of the finished library.

base_medium.q: M9 media supplemented with 0.1% casamino acids, 0.4% glycerol, 0.4% glucose

medium_class.q: M9 media supplemented with 0.1% casamino acids, 0.4% glycerol, 0.4% glucose

amino_acids_supplied.q: M9 media supplemented with 0.1% casamino acids

culture_mode.q: grown 3-4 hours to an OD600 of ~0.35 at 37°C in an orbital shaker at 200 RPM

oxygen.q: in an orbital shaker at 200 RPM

growth_temperature.q: Cultures were back-diluted to OD600 = 0.2 and grown at 30 °C for 30 min before being infected with T7 at MOI = 5.

growth_phase.q: Overnight cultures were back diluted into fresh media and grown 3-4 hours to an OD600 of ~0.35 at 37°C in an orbital shaker at 200 RPM.

inducer_added.q: Two replicates each of +toxIN (pBR322-toxIN) and -toxIN (pBR322 empty vector) cells

assay_class.q: samples were treated with a custom rRNA depletion kit

rrna_removal.q: samples were treated with a custom rRNA depletion kit
